PRIVACY POLICY & TERMS OF SERVICE
--------------------------------------
Effective Date: The moment you downloaded this.

1. ZERO TELEMETRY PLEDGE
   Clip-CACHE ("The App") is built on a foundation of privacy and transparency.
   - WE DO NOT want your data.
   - WE DO NOT track your usage.
   - WE DO NOT send analytics to the cloud.
   - WE DO NOT inject ads or spyware.
   
   The App operates entirely locally. Your Clipboard History (Database) is stored in a local SQLite file (`history.db`) within your user directory. You have full control to purge, wipe, or delete this data at any time via the "ADMIN" or "SETTINGS" tabs.

2. LOCAL DATA SECURITY
   Because your data is stored locally, it is as secure as your computer.
   - If your computer is compromised by malware, your clipboard history may be accessible to that malware.
   - SmartBoard attempts to mask sensitive checks but cannot defend against kernel-level compromise of your OS.
   - Use "Tabula Rasa" (Nuke All) if you are working with extremely sensitive data and wish to ensure it is wiped from the App's records.

3. USER CONDUCT
   By using this App, you agree NOT to:
   - Use the App for illegal activities (obviously).
   - Attempt to reverse engineer the App's "Nuclear" protections to extract proprietary logic (though it's open source-ish, just don't be a jerk).
   - Blame the Creator if you lose your clipboard history because you clicked "TABULA RASA" without reading the 20-foot tall warning sign.

4. UPDATES
   The App may check for updates (if that feature is ever built), but it will do so by querying a version manifest, not by sending your personal info. Currently, it does not even do that. It is a ghost.

5. FINAL WORD
   This tool is for Power Users. It assumes you know what you are doing. Use it to Be Your Best.
   
   Signed,
   h4
